items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: when I joined Mercer Ellington’s band

ctx.x: You only had a month off then.

And I’d take off during Thanksgiving and I wouldn’t go back to work until the first of the year. I never played New Year’s Eve. It was like during that period -- for instance you take Ohio, you could play Ohio man, you could stay in Ohio almost two years because at that time all the joints, man you were booked for four or five weeks at a run, you know. It was no one night or two nights and things like that. You stayed in a joint two or three weeks at a time, you dig? And like I said man, you could stay in Ohio.…
I was going to ask you, what year was that? For how long?
